1. Proof-of-work blockchains are vulnerable to the Balance attack.

(a) the balance attack is a new attack against proof-of-work blockchains that is based on a delay in the network communication between two groups of nodes with balanced power, and (b) the balance attack against Ethereum can be executed in less than 30 minutes with a single machine.
• The Balance attack can be used to double spend on the R3 testnet with high probability, and that • The attack is feasible with a single machine, as we demonstrate on the private Ethereum testnet.
